name: slicer-bomb-dqn-40960-v1
declared: 2026-10-31 before extending the in-setting training budget
purpose: Check whether scratch Double DQN in-setting references on three bomb-heavy Slicer settings remain cautious after twice the 20,480-step budget.
eval_policy: greedy argmax, same as the 22 October difficulty protocol
aggregation: Report each seed and five-seed mean with the existing seed-level 2000-resample bootstrap 95% interval. Compare the two checkpoints descriptively; no significance claim from their overlapping episodes.
acceptance: At 20,480 steps, each seed must reproduce the committed in-setting reference score, bomb hits and return exactly. If this fails, report failure and make no 40,960-step comparison.
interpretation: If bomb hits stay low, cautious play persists to 40,960 steps for these exact seeds and settings; if they rise, report the change. Do not call a fruit-score change a transfer improvement, and do not generalize to SB3 DQN, PPO, other settings or a new held-out test.
